title: DC-area forecast: Hot Friday with another storm chance, then improving for holiday weekend
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Overnight storms left behind muggy conditions this morning. Temperatures start in the 70s and head toward highs in the upper 80s to low 90s. More scattered showers and storms are possible, especially after 4 p.m., with some potentially strong.

What's next? Scattered storms are possible into the night. Eventually, it turns noticeably cooler and less humid for the holiday weekend, and that comfortable stretch holds into early next week before temperatures climb again by midweek.

Today’s daily digit — 4/10: Our final day of hot and humid conditions, with potentially strong storms. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.

Forecast in detail

Today (Friday): A stalled front nearby may spark a brief morning shower, then better chances for scattered strong to potentially severe thunderstorms develop during the afternoon and evening — some capable of damaging wind gusts. Highs mainly in the upper 80s to low 90s, and with dew points still near 70, heat index values may approach or surpass 100, especially south of DC. Confidence: Medium

Tonight: Scattered showers and a thunderstorm remain a risk into the evening before tapering off around midnight. Clearing the humidity out could still be slow, so it may stay muggy. Lows in the upper 60s to mid-70s, with some patchy fog possible. Confidence: Medium

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Saturday: Partly sunny with decreasing humidity, but a few showers or rumbles are still possible, mainly in the afternoon and especially west and south of DC. Highs head for the mid-80s. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: A stray shower is possible but, overall, skies gradually clear as drier air filters in. Lows near 60 to mid-60s. Confidence: Medium

Sunday: Genuinely nice — mainly sunny, comfortably less humid, with highs in the upper 70s to low 80s. Confidence: Medium-High 😎 Nice Day!

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Sunday night: Mostly clear and comfortably cool. Lows in the mid-50s to low 60s. Confidence: Medium

The pleasant stretch continues Labor Day and Tuesday, with partly to mostly sunny skies both days, mainly low humidity, and highs near 80 to the mid-80s. Overnight lows fall into the upper 50s to mid-60s. A great setup for any holiday outdoor plans. Confidence: Medium

Temperatures trend back up starting Wednesday, with highs potentially eyeing 90 as early as Wednesday and probably surpassing 90 by Thursday as humidity slowly builds again.

DC weather history for September 4

A ferocious 1939 thunderstorm dumped nearly 4.5 inches of rain in just a couple of hours, flooding streets, stranding cars, and overwhelming basements across the city.
